title: Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator
description:
Full-Time - Monday-Friday - Hybrid - L3 apprenticeship in Recruitment (18 months)

Salary: £25,311 per annum

Looking to start your career in Recruitment and Talent Acquisition?

Are you organised, confident communicating with people, and eager to learn? Do you enjoy building relationships and want to develop a career in recruitment while gaining a nationally recognised qualification?

If so, why not start your recruitment journey with Staffline?

Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator

This is a hybrid role, splitting your time between working from home and our Nottingham office.

As an Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you'll join our Talent Acquisition team while completing a Level 3 Recruitment Apprenticeship over 18 months. You'll gain hands-on experience supporting recruitment activities across a variety of roles while developing the skills and knowledge needed for a successful career in Talent Acquisition.

Working closely with the Talent Acquisition team, hiring managers and candidates, you'll help deliver a positive and efficient recruitment experience from attraction through to onboarding.

What you'll do as an Apprentice Talent Acquisition Coordinator

This is a fantastic opportunity to learn from experienced recruitment professionals and develop your career with the UK's largest recruiter.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Supporting the Talent Acquisition team with recruitment activity across a range of vacancies.
- Advertising vacancies across job boards, social media channels and other attraction platforms.
- Sourcing potential candidates and building talent pipelines.
- Screening applications and carrying out initial candidate conversations.
- Coordinating interviews and maintaining communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
- Supporting hiring managers with recruitment administration and scheduling.
- Maintaining accurate candidate records within recruitment systems.
- Providing regular updates to candidates and stakeholders to ensure a positive recruitment experience.
- Supporting recruitment projects, employer branding initiatives and talent attraction campaigns.
- Completing your Level 3 Recruitment Resourcer Apprenticeship and applying your learning within the workplace.

What you'll need to succeed

We're looking for someone with enthusiasm, curiosity and a genuine interest in developing a career in recruitment.

You'll ideally have:
- A strong interest in recruitment, Talent Acquisition or Human Resources.
- Excellent communication skills and confidence speaking with a range of people.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
- Good attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.
- A positive attitude and willingness to learn.
- The ability to build relationships and work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office applications.
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths would be advantageous.

What you'll gain
- A Level 3 Recruitment Apprenticeship qualification.
- Hands-on experience within an in-house Talent Acquisition team.
- Ongoing support and mentoring from experienced recruitment professionals.
- Opportunities to develop your recruitment, sourcing and stakeholder management skills.
- A strong foundation for a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR.

Why join us?

This role offers the opportunity to develop your recruitment career within a supportive Talent Acquisition team, working across a variety of business areas while gaining valuable in-house recruitment experience.

Like the sound of this? Apply now, or get in touch with the Talent Acquisition team for further information.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Contract HR Administrator Nottingham, East Midlands Full-Time, Onsite Up to £27,000 + Benefits

Are you an organised and proactive HR Administrator looking for an immediate start? Our client is seeking the support of a confident and accurate HR Administrator to support them with an important project. We are looking for somebody who is attentive to detail, adaptable, and eager to support their HR team. This role suits someone with previous experience in HR administration, ready to hit the ground running and contribute to a dynamic environment.

As an interim HR Administrator, you will support the HR team with a specific project. This role will involve a lot of data entry - so accuracy to detail is key. The HR Team are extremely busy at the minute of the back of 2 acquisitions as such, they will be needing some support for at least the next couple of months.

Full training and support will be given, but they are looking for somebody with previous experience working within a HR function.

What we are looking for

We are seeking a highly organised individual with exceptional attention to detail who has previous experience in HR administration and who can work effectively under pressure.
- Proven experience as an HR Administrator or Assistant
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent attention to detail and confidentiality
- Proficient in MS Office suite and HRIS systems
- Immediate availability for a 2-month contract
- A proactive and approachable character with a team-focused mindset

Don't miss out on this opportunity to join a fantastic HR team, within a very reputable organisation for an immediate contract. If you meet the criteria and are ready to bring your HR expertise to this role, we would love to hear from you.

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant
Nottingham £26,000 - £28,000

Are you an organised and detail-focused HR Administrator looking for an immediate start with a brilliant organisation?
We are delighted to be supporting a well-established Business in the search for an HR Assistant to join their team temporarily for an initial two months, with the potential to extend.
This is a great opportunity for someone with strong administrative skills to provide valuable support to the HR team, clear a backlog of outstanding work, and help ensure the smooth running of day-to-day operations.
The Role
Working closely with the HR team, you will provide essential administrative support, including:
- Supporting with a backlog of general HR administration from previous HR teams.
- Completing high volumes of accurate data entry and maintaining HR records.
- Filing and organising employee documentation.
- Chasing references and following up outstanding information.
- Checking and photocopying IDs, certificates and other employee documentation.
- Assisting with general HR administration and ensuring records are kept up to date.
- Providing additional administrative support to the HR team as required.

About You
You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in an HR, personnel or general administrative role.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills.
- Confidence working with confidential employee information.
- A methodical approach to data entry, filing and record keeping.
- The ability to manage repetitive administrative tasks efficiently while maintaining accuracy.
- A proactive approach and the ability to work independently.
- Good communication skills and confidence chasing outstanding information when required.

Apply ASAP for further information.

title: Talent Acquisition Operations Assistant
description:
Nottingham Trent House (95002), United Kingdom, Nottingham, Nottinghamshire

Talent Acquisition Operations Assistant

About this role

Our Talent Acquisition Operations team manages interview scheduling, offer management, onboarding of new starters and everything in-between, no day is the same. Success in this role isn't about ticking boxes, but about delivering real value.

We're looking for a dedicated, process driven, results focused Talent Acquisition Assistant to join our energetic and client focused Talent Acquisition Operations team.

What you'll do
- Support recruiters and stakeholders to provide an exceptional candidate experience by delivering a seamless recruitment process
- Build trusted relationships with recruiters, hiring managers and candidates
- Manage all aspects of interview scheduling across the team, this is often high volume so you'll need to be comfortable handling multiple requests
- Create and issue employment contracts within an agreed SLA
- Process new starters through our Applicant Tracking System; Workday and manage all new starter communications up to their first day
- Process and monitor background checks for all new starters via our third-party partner

What we're looking for
- You'll have exceptional organisational skills, are comfortable managing multiple workloads and able to prioritise your own workload
- You'll be an excellent communicator and able to build good relationships with colleagues and candidates
- You pay close attention to detail and care about providing error-free work
- You're a great team player and are always willing to get involved and support colleagues when times get busy
- You can stay calm and focused whilst managing multiple priorities

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in our Nottingham office.

We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.

Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft. Our London office boasts a rooftop running track and coffee bar.

What's in it for you
- Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:
- Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
- Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
- Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.
- A full list of our benefits is available here .

What you should know about how we recruit

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it's about what you do, not just what you say. That's why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.

We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture-one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas-and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

Who We Are
At Capital One, we're building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.
Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.
